{{Top|leg}}
'''Scholar-lawyers''' were a small class of sows within [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] society. They kept track of the extensive and complex nature of Gamorrean genealogy, memorizing sagas listing wars, heroic deeds, and property exchanges.
